calibration.ats_outcome: whether the consensus ATS pick covered; pushes excluded
calibration.curve: percent correct among all picks with confidence greater than or equal to each cutoff from 0.50 through 1.00
calibration.moneyline_outcome: whether the consensus straight-up pick won; price availability is not required

cfbd_limitation: CFBD betting-line records provide spread, opening spread, total, and moneylines, but no price for either side of the point spread.

confidence_staking.ats_confidence: share of underlying models supporting the published consensus ATS side
confidence_staking.moneyline_confidence: published win probability assigned to the selected team

confidence_threshold_sweep.warning: in-sample season-to-date diagnostic; selecting a cutoff on these outcomes is not forward validation

missing_line_policy: No ATS bet is placed when the frozen spread or grade is missing.
moneyline_missing_price_policy: No moneyline bet is placed when CFBD has no quoted price for the selected team.
moneyline_odds_source: best available quoted price across CFBD providers
moneyline_policy: CFBD moneyline odds are not used as ATS odds.
moneyline_timing_policy: Use the frozen pregame CFBD moneyline snapshot when present; otherwise label the quote as retrospective and do not claim it was available at prediction time.

settlement.win: stake returned plus stake * 100 / abs(odds) for negative odds
